newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Conasupo buys 1.15 mln T corn in 3 months.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Conasupo buys 1.15 mln T corn in 3 months.

text.p: Mexican national staples agency Conasupo has bought 1.15 million tonnes of corn in the last three months from 28 states across the country as part of its annual program offering floor prices to growers.
In a statement, Conasupo said Monday the purchases from Mexico's autumn-winter crop cycle represented 52 percent of planned total acquisitions of 2.0 million tonnes in the cycle.

Conasupo is a guaranteed buyer of corn for Mexican corn farmers if they are unable to sell product through the private sector. Conasupo the re-sells the corn, mainly to corn-pancake tortilla makers, helping to assure food stocks in poor zones.
Conasupo said its most significant purchases were 386,000 tonnes in Chiapas state, 217,500 tonnes in Jalisco, 104,500 in Chihuahua, 66,100 tonnes in Puebla and 56,200 tonnes in Nayarit state.

Prices paid to growers differ on a state-to-state basis, although Conasupo said it is has paid up to 50 percent above international corn prices at times in the last three months to maintain production incentives. It gave no specific prices.
The buying programme for the autumn-winter cycle will end on April 30 when the normal growing period ends. Mexico also has a spring summer growing cycle.
